title: Samurai Sabre
body:
Syntax: samurai sabre

Description: Toggle a chakra edge on a wielded sword. Ordinary sword hits deal 20% more damage while active. Costs 4 Chakra per idle 10 seconds, or 6 Chakra and 2 Stamina per combat round. Switch weapons or use it again to turn it off. Requires a wielded sword. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 35. Costs 35 Chakra and 10 Stamina; 25 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
